evidence.summary: Help page: photograph a receipt and Tallyho fills in merchant, date and total; the user can correct any field.
Help page: receipts in a foreign currency are converted to the user's home currency.
Screenshot 'Scanned receipt': merchant, total in the receipt currency with an approximate converted amount (12.40 GBP shown as about 14.43 EUR), and Edit and Save actions; no date field is visible.
User-reported, not seen by Claude: used on a phone; after scanning the total is usually right but the date is often wrong and is fixed by hand.
Help page: people are invited to a budget by email, everyone in a budget sees its expenses, and the budget owner can remove members.
Help page: budgets reset monthly (what a reset does is not described).
Screenshot of a budget: name and member count, 'Spent 412.30 of 600.00 EUR', member list with one marked owner, and Invite and Remove member actions.
User-reported, not seen by Claude: after a member was removed from a budget, that member's earlier expenses stayed in the budget.
API: GET /v2/expenses?budget_id= returns a list of expenses with id, merchant, amount, currency, date and category (types not given).
API: POST /v2/expenses creates an expense; request body and response are not described.
API: GET /v2/budgets lists the budgets the token's user belongs to.
API: personal access token in the Authorization header; rate limit 60 requests per minute.

architecture.frontend: Phone app or mobile web (user scans on a phone); technology unknown
architecture.backend: Hosted service with a versioned REST API (v2); internals not inspectable

workflows.name: Scan a receipt into an expense
edge_cases: date extracted wrongly and corrected by hand (user-reported)
receipt in a foreign currency is converted

workflows.name: Manage a shared budget's members
edge_cases: removed member's earlier expenses stay in the budget (user-reported)

features.name: Receipt scanning
features.description: Photograph a receipt; merchant, date and total are filled in and can be corrected before saving the expense.
features.observed_behaviour: Screenshot shows the review screen after a scan with merchant and total filled and Edit/Save actions. The user reports the total is usually right but the date is often wrong.
features.business_logic: Extracted fields: merchant, date, total. Any field can be corrected. Category is not among the fields documented as extracted.
features.integration: Needs an OCR/receipt-extraction service (provider unknown) and image capture on a phone.

features.name: Foreign-currency conversion
features.description: An expense in a foreign currency is converted to the home currency; the screenshot shows the original amount with an approximate converted amount.
features.observed_behaviour: Screenshot: 12.40 GBP shown with about 14.43 EUR.
features.business_logic: Converted to the user's home currency (documented). Rate source, rate date and rounding unknown.

features.name: Shared budgets
features.description: A budget with a spending limit that several members share; everyone in it sees its expenses and the spent-vs-limit total.
features.observed_behaviour: Screenshot: 'Groceries budget · 3 members', 'Spent 412.30 of 600.00 EUR', members listed with one owner.
features.business_logic: Members see all expenses of the budget. One owner per budget (seen). Budget has a limit and a currency (seen).

features.name: Invite members by email
features.description: Invite a person to a budget by email address.
features.observed_behaviour: Invite button seen on the budget screen; the invitation flow itself was not seen.
features.business_logic: Unknown: whether invitees must accept, expiry, inviting someone without an account.

features.name: Owner removes members
features.description: The budget owner removes a member; per the user's notes the removed member's earlier expenses stay in the budget.
features.observed_behaviour: Remove member button seen; the user reports earlier expenses of a removed member stayed in the budget.
features.business_logic: Only the owner may remove members (documented). Removed member's expenses remain (user-reported). Whether the removed member keeps any access is unknown.

features.name: Monthly budget reset
features.business_logic: Documented as 'budgets reset monthly'; presumably the spent total restarts each month. Whether expenses are kept, which day and which time zone are unknown.

features.name: Expense category field
features.description: Each expense carries a category (seen only as a field in the API).
features.business_logic: Allowed values, whether users can define categories, and how a scanned receipt gets one are unknown.

features.name: Record and list expenses
features.description: Create expenses (merchant, amount, currency, date, category) and list a budget's expenses.
features.business_logic: Expense fields per the API: id, merchant, amount, currency, date, category; listing filtered by budget.

features.name: Public API with personal access tokens
features.description: A versioned REST API (v2) to list and create expenses and list budgets, authenticated with a personal access token.
features.business_logic: Rate limit 60 requests per minute. Token scopes, expiry and error format unknown.

error_handling.case: wrongly extracted field after a scan
error_handling.behaviour: user corrects it by hand on the review screen

unknowns: How receipt extraction works (provider, accuracy, which languages and layouts); only its result screen and the user's notes are available. A test account session with the user present would show more.
Why the date is often wrong (date formats such as DD/MM vs MM/DD, or picking the wrong date on the receipt); the user's examples would settle it.
Whether scanning sets a category; the help page lists merchant, date and total only.
Exchange-rate source, rate date (receipt date or scan date), rounding, and whether the original amount is stored; the screenshot shows both values.
Home currency vs budget currency: which one budget totals use when members have different home currencies.
What a monthly reset does (spent total restarts? expenses archived?), on which day and in which time zone.
Invitation flow: acceptance, expiry, inviting people without an account, re-inviting a removed member.
After removal: whether the removed member can still see the budget or their own expenses in it.
Whether more than one owner, ownership transfer, or budget deletion exist.
Expense field types (id, amount), whether amounts are stored as decimals or minor units, and the POST /v2/expenses request body.
App sign-in method, session handling, token scopes and expiry; API error format and pagination.
Tech stack and data storage: closed product, backend not inspectable.
Category values in Tallyho and whether users can create categories.
Live product, public website and the user's account could not be inspected here (no browser or web fetch approved).
